section_173.requirement: Minimum 7 days notice in writing to every director; quorum under Section 174.

section_179.requirement: Exercise of financial and corporate powers; delegation under Section 179(3) where permissible.

section_118.scope: Minutes of Proceedings of General Meeting, Meeting of Board of Directors and other meetings
section_118.requirement: Entry in minutes book within 30 days, signed by Chairman of the meeting or next succeeding meeting.

secretarial_standard_1.scope: ICSI Secretarial Standard on Meetings of the Board of Directors
secretarial_standard_1.requirement: Strict adherence to paragraphs 1.2.1 (Notice), 7.1.1 (Minutes entry), and 8.1 (Preservation).
